items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: What does he play? Clarinet. Phil Gomez.

ctx.x: Yeah. All right. Now, and we did another one for Verve at the All Star. And it was supposed to be one that would go into, uh, what they call a capsule. Mm-hmm. So, I don't know if it had been released or not, but I noticed, I got a letter about a few weeks ago from the union. And, um, they told me to, uh, search into it. All right. Uh, about, um, that, that recording session. Because there may be money for me. Mm-hmm. Because, uh, I was working in, when they were doing it for the Verve, I was working in Medford,…
What does he play? Clarinet. Phil Gomez. Mm-hmm.
Clarinet. Um, did you remember this? Clarinet. The trumpet player played the horn in the movie with Jack Webb, the color fellow.
